item.title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Game Awards Nominee Is Ready for Resident Evil 10
item.description: Angela Sant'Albano had never performed in a video game before Resident Evil Requiem . She'd never done motion capture, either. But after spending months physically throwing herself into the horror of Grace Ashcroft's story, she came away convinced that the medium was a perfect fit.

item.title: When Are The Game Awards 2026: Date, Time, and How to Watch
item.description: The biggest annual video game awards ceremony, The Game Awards , is almost here, likely bringing big wins, a few upsets, too many game trailers, and maybe even an acceptance speech or two.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Boss Reveals the Next Marvel Set’s Surprising Origin Story
item.description: Magic: The Gathering has already released two Universes Beyond sets based on Marvel Comics , with Marvel’s Spider-Man in 2025 and Marvel Super Heroes in 2026. The game’s designers are taking a very different approach to their third tie-in set, Darkhold Destiny , which will launch in 2027. Rather than simply making cards based on iconic characters and comic book arcs, Wizards of the Coast designers worked with Marvel to create an entirely new storyline designed with the game’s mechanics in mind. Magic ’s vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon at MagicCon Atlanta that the inspiration for the new approach came from an unlikely source.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Awards Nominations Are Exactly What Everyone Predicted
item.description: Going into Tuesday’s reveal of the 2026 Game Awards nominees , the question wasn’t whether or not Grand Theft Auto 6 would pick up any nominations. It was more about how many nominations it would get. And now that the dust has cleared, GTA 6 ’s Game Awards nominations rolled out pretty much…exactly as expected.

item.title: Target Officially Reveals Big Pokémon TCG Deals On Black Friday
item.description: November is here, and retailers are finally revealing how they'll handle the year's biggest shopping event: Black Friday. Target has offered Black Friday deals on the Pokémon trading card game in previous years, and 2026 looks to be no different.

item.title: We've almost reached Peak Sauron
item.description: Rings of Power showrunner Patrick McKay says Sauron isn't the Dark Lord yet... but he's getting there.

item.title: Dune Magic: The Gathering Crossover Officially Confirmed After Major Leak
item.description: The spice must flow, and so must the Secret Lair drops. After several days of leaks circulating online , Dune is officially crossing over with Magic: The Gathering , with Wizards of the Coast teasing the collaboration through the official MTG Secret Lair account.

item.title: 8 Biggest Snubs in the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.description: The Game Awards has announced its official list of nominees for this year’s prizes. Among the nominees are plenty of obvious contenders, such as Grand Theft Auto 6 , Resident Evil Requiem , and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . There was stiff competition across several categories, meaning that some worthy games — and Polygon favorites — didn’t make the shortlist for certain prizes. These are the biggest TGA nomination snubs of 2026.

item.title: The Mighty Nein Season 2 Officially Has Fans Worried About One Major Plot Change
item.description: The Mighty Nein season 2 is officially set to return to our TV screens in March 2027. And while Critical Role fans may be a little put out by Amazon's new episode schedule, the season’s content has Critters excited for what’s to come from our band of lovable misfits.

item.title: New 'Pokémon' TCG Lucario Set Leaks In Stores Months Before Official Release
item.description: The Pokémon Trading Card Game's latest set, Delta Reign , just came out a couple of weeks ago in early November. The next set, Flowing Fists, isn't scheduled to drop for another few months. Most people haven't seen Delta Reign boxes in stores yet, never mind the recent Pokémon 30th Anniversary set . Despite all of this, real people have apparently already acquired packs of Flowing Fist. Heck, some people have already pulled the next set's chase card — which hasn't even been formally revealed yet!
